Our guest today is Congresswoman Laurel Lee, who was elected to the U.S. House of Representatives in 2022 and proudly represents the 15th Congressional District of Florida, which encompasses Eastern Hillsboro County, as well as parts of Pasco and Polk counties. Prior to her election, Congresswoman Lee served as Florida's 36th Secretary of State under the DeSantis administration from January 2019 to May 2022. During her tenure, she worked to strengthen Florida's elections, infrastructure, and cybersecurity defenses, and ensured accurate and secure elections in our state. Before becoming Secretary of State, she served as a Circuit Court Judge in Florida's 13th Judicial Circuit in Hillsborough County. Before becoming a Judge, Congresswoman Lee served as a Federal Prosecutor for the United States Attorney's Office in the Middle District of Florida. As a federal prosecutor, she investigated and litigated false claims at cases and initiated and prosecuted a wide range of criminal offenses, including white collar crime, violent crime, and offenses involving sexual exploitation of children. Congresswoman Lee serves on the House Judiciary and Homeland Security Committees. Her main focus on these committees includes government accountability and transparency, and protecting our nation from threats both abroad and at home. She has been an ardent supporter of law enforcement and for the Sheriff's of Florida, and we appreciate her taking the time to visit with us today. Congresswoman Laurel Lee, thank you for joining us.
